done_when: forge read records a round as passed when its only numbered items say there are no findings (in any common wording), and notes like 'tests were not run' don't count as findings; the reader's instructions ask for the plain no-findings form; a real finding still fails the round; a command test with a faked reader covers the numbered 'No findings' form, the plain form and a real finding, for a new repo and one adopted on an earlier release
why: A cold read that found nothing is recorded as not passed when the reader writes 'No findings' as a numbered item (for example '6. No findings.' plus a note that tests weren't run), so forge next asks for a disposition on it and the plan pays an extra read round (reported by a client session, 2026-10-09)
